jobs.description:
Looking for a job where you can grow, work with modern technology, and make a real difference every day? Join DHL Supply Chain in Wijchen/Nijmegen and become part of a team that keeps essential products moving around the world. Wie zoeken we? You don’t need years of experience, we’re looking for the right attitude. You speak Dutch or English You’re motivated and enjoy practical, hands-on work You’re accurate and responsible You’re willing to learn and develop yourself You’re able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) You’re comfortable working in a dynamic logistics environment Wat bieden wij je? At DHL, you’ll get more than just a job. You’ll have the opportunity to develop yourself while working for one of the world’s leading logistics companies. Monthly salary of €2,610 Full-time or part-time working options Extra bonuses for overtime and evening shifts from 18:00 onwards 8.33% holiday allowance Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per day Opportunities to obtain valuable logistics certifications Pension accrual after 8 working weeks Opportunities for career development and internal growth Possibility of a permanent contract Functieomschrijving At DHL, you’re not just another employee. You’ll work in a modern, clean, and high-tech logistics environment where teamwork, quality, and accuracy are key. You’ll handle a wide range of products, including important pharmaceutical goods. Your work helps ensure that essential and sometimes life-saving products reach the people who need them, making your contribution truly meaningful. Whether you’re looking for a full-time or part-time job, this could be your next step. Your role as a Logistics Operator As a Logistics Operator, you make sure customer orders are processed accurately and ready to leave the warehouse on time. Your day is varied, active, and hands-on. Your responsibilities include: Picking and preparing customer orders for shipment Checking, counting, and managing inventory Printing labels and preparing

packages Processing returns accurately Packing shipments and preparing them for transport Following DHL’s quality, safety, and hygiene procedures You don’t need previous logistics experience. We’ll teach you everything you need to know. Because you’ll be working with pharmaceutical products, you’ll receive thorough training and guidance from day one. Grow with DHL At DHL, your development matters. Once you’ve mastered your role, there are opportunities to expand your skills and take additional training or certifications, such as: EPT Forklift Reach truck OPT And if you’re ambitious, there are opportunities to grow into positions with more responsibility, such as Team Leader. Excited? So are we! Send your questions via WhatsApp or apply directly with the button. We can’t wait to hear from you and welcome you to DHL Supply Chain.

Looking for a job where your schedule fits your life, not the other way around? This is your chance to be part of a fast-moving distribution center that keeps major supermarkets running every single day. As an order picker, you work in a modern, clean and well-organized warehouse where teamwork and efficiency go hand in hand. You play an essential role in making sure thousands of products reach supermarket shelves on time: You’re always on the move in a dynamic environment. The best part? Flexibility is key. Together with planning, you choose your working hours, ranging from 16 to 40 hours per week. You can work Monday through Friday between 06:00 and 22:00, on Saturday between 06:00 and 18:00 and on Sunday between 06:00 and 12:00. Whether you want to earn extra alongside your studies or go full-time, it fits around you.

You start your day by getting your gear ready and checking your tasks. Then you begin picking orders for well-known supermarkets, making sure every product is collected accurately and carefully packed. You stay sharp on quality, keep your workspace tidy, and make sure everything runs smoothly. Show what you’re capable of, and there’s more waiting for you: after just 7 months, you can earn a permanent contract directly with the employer, based on fulltime. On top of that, there are real opportunities to grow within the company.

Ready to turn your energy into impact? Apply today and get started.

- Experience in logistics is an advantage
- Accurate and independent working attitude
- Physical health and a good working pace
- Fluent in English

jobs.description:
As an experienced forklift driver, you will work for a specialist in the fruit and vegetable (AGF) sector. Operating a forklift, you will use your keen attention to detail to ensure that the right products end up in the right place. If you notice that a fellow forklift driver is busy moving pallets, you will not hesitate to lend a helping hand. Teamwork and collegiality are therefore highly important!
Pallets loaded with mangoes or avocados arrive via shipping containers or trucks, after which the quality is checked immediately. Once approved, you will ensure that the goods are moved and stored correctly.
You will work weekdays from 06:30 to 16:00 (with possible overtime when required) and will also be available to work one Saturday per month. Overtime worked after 38 hours per week is paid at 135% of the regular hourly rate.
For this position, it is important that you can work comfortably in a cool environment of approximately 10°C (50°F). To keep you warm, our client will provide you with a thick work jacket.

- Experience as a forklift driver
- Good command of both Dutch and English
- Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment
- Full-time availability and looking for a permanent position
- Own transportation
- Living in or around Rotterdam, The Hague, Zoetermeer, or Bleiswijk

- Testing the final products for quality and consistency

jobs.description:
Looking to gain real-world hospitality experience in a boutique hotel setting? At Park Plaza Vondelpark Amsterdam, you'll learn how exceptional service, attention to detail and genuine guest connections come together to create memorable stays from arrival to departure. Situated in Amsterdam's Oud-Zuid district, close to the iconic Vondelpark and excellent public transport links, Park Plaza Vondelpark Amsterdam is a stylish boutique hotel where personalised service and authentic hospitality take centre stage.

As a Front Office Intern, you will be the face of the hotel and play a key role in creating memorable guest experiences. You will gain hands-on experience in all aspects of Front Office operations while developing your professional and hospitality skills in a welcoming and dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

• Support guests throughout their stay, from check-in to check-out

• Deliver a warm and professional welcome to guests from around the world

• Assist with guest enquiries via phone, email and face-to-face communication

• Learn and apply hotel procedures, standards and systems

• Collaborate with departments such as Housekeeping, Food & Beverage and Maintenance to ensure seamless guest experiences

• Contribute to maintaining a professional and welcoming Front Office environment

Essential Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a hospitality, hotel management or related study programme

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and develop

• Guest-focused mindset with a positive and professional approach

• Enjoy working as part of a team and adapting to a fast-paced environment

• Eligible to complete an internship in the Netherlands

Preferred Requirements

• Previous experience in hospitality or customer service is an advantage

• Interest in Front Office operations and guest relations

• Familiarity with hotel systems (PMS) is a plus

• Dutch or additional language skills are

As a Cleanroom Foil Employee, you will work in a clean production environment where high-tech components are packaged and protected for international transport. You will work accurately based on technical drawings and work instructions.

Your tasks include:

- Cutting foil using production machines for high-tech packaging
- Packaging fragile components for air transport
- Cleaning and packing products and components
- Assembling packaging materials according to instructions
- Working according to cleanroom rules and safety procedures
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Keeping the workplace and cleanroom environment clean and organized

You will work in a 2-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- Week 1: Monday to Friday from 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: Monday to Friday from 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- Experience as an assembly or production employee is a plus
- Technical insight and interest in production processes
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language
- Accurate and quality-focused work attitude
- Living in the Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard region is a plus

As an assembly worker, you will be responsible for assembling and testing electronic products in a modern, high-tech working environment. You will work full-time on the evening shift from 07:00 till 16:00. The position offers opportunities for personal and professional development, including internal training.

Your responsibilities include following digital work instructions, collecting components, assembling products, and performing quality checks. You will work with tasks such as screwing, manual gluing, assembly, and functional testing. You may also operate robots and be responsible for programming and quality control.

You will carefully record your work and work closely with your fellow assembly workers to meet deadlines and maintain high-quality standards.

This is a long-term position with the possibility of a permanent contract, depending on your performance and commitment.

Would you like to work in a high-tech environment with plenty of opportunities to grow? Apply now for this exciting Assembly Worker position!

- Mbo-level education or equivalent working and thinking level
- Technical affinity and experience with fine electronics is a plus
- Good command of the English language
- Flexibility to work overtime and a precise, accurate working attitude
- A team player with a strong eye for detail

Are you technically inclined, do you enjoy working with metal, and do you know what to do with a MIG/MAG welding machine? Then we have a great full-time job for you! 
For an international manufacturing company, we are looking for a MIG/MAG Welder / Metalworker. You will be working on the production of metal stable systems and components for the livestock industry. This is a practical role where you work independently but are also part of a team. This is what we offer - Salary: €17.74 gross per hour - Hours: 38-40 hours per week - Working hours: Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 17:00, including a 90-minute break - A long-term full-time job in the Municipality of Koggeland - Working in an international team - A varied technical position What are you going to do? 
As a MIG/MAG Welder / Bench Worker, you will be involved in various metalworking activities. Your work includes: - Welding metal parts using the MIG/MAG method - The processing and working of various metals and materials - Reading technical drawings and work orders - Operating machines and various hand tools - Checking the quality and neat finish of your work - Supporting colleagues with various tasks within production What do we expect from you? - You have a technical education, preferably in metalworking or mechanical engineering. - You have experience with MIG/MAG welding. - You possess a welding certificate - You are skilled with hand tools and machines - You work accurately and have an eye for quality. - You are open to working with various materials and techniques. - You can manage well in English or Dutch. - You are looking for a long-term job. About the company 
You will be working at an international manufacturing company that develops and produces high-quality stable systems for sheep and goats. This includes fencing, feed barriers, farrowing pens, and various metal accessorie...

What will you do?

As a TIG Welder, you will work closely with a small and experienced team to build high-quality stainless steel filter systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- TIG welding of stainless steel components (RVS/INOX)
- Assembling parts based on technical drawings
- Welding both precision components and larger constructions
- Checking dimensions and product quality
- Contributing ideas for technical improvements and solutions
- Helping build complete filtration systems from start to finish

- Experience as a TIG Welder
- Experience with stainless steel (preferred)
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good communication skills in English, German, or Dutch
- Eye for detail and quality
- Motivated and reliable attitude

Are you looking for an active warehouse job that fits perfectly with your personal life? Then this is your chance! We are currently looking for motivated order pickers and packers who can start immediately and are available for both morning and afternoon shifts. Using modern tools such as hand scanners and voice picking, you will collect orders quickly and accurately. You make sure every order is complete and ready for shipment.

In this role, you will stay active throughout the day and play an important part in keeping the logistics process running smoothly.

Working hours (2 shift system):

- Morning: 07:00 – 16:00
- Afternoon: 16:00 – 00:00

- You speak English or Dutch
- You are available at least 2 days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2 shift system
- You are physically able to perform active work (standing, walking, lifting)
- No experience is required, motivation are most important
- Resident of the Netherlands
- Valid work permit for the Netherlands required
- No housing available

As an orderpicker / warehouse worker, you make sure that all orders are collected accurately and neatly. Using a handheld scanner or picking list, you move through the warehouse and collect the correct products.

Your responsibilities

- Collecting orders using a picking list or handheld scanner
- Checking that products are complete and correct
- Packing orders and preparing them for shipment
- Moving products within the warehouse
- Keeping your workplace clean and safe
- Working together with your colleagues to complete everything on time

You will work from Monday to Friday, from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM (07.00 till 16.00), so you are free in the evenings and weekends

As an orderpicker / warehouse worker, you have:

- Experience as an orderpicker, warehouse worker or simular in the logistics would be great but is not required
- Availability for 40 hours per week
- A hands-on attitude and the physical fitness to stand and walk throughout the day
- No Dutch required, English is enough
- Residence in or near Oss, Nijmegen or Wijchen

As a logistics employee, you handle incoming and outgoing goods every day. You unpack and check products, and prepare them for shipment. You also ensure the warehouse remains tidy and organized. You work with scanners and sometimes a forklift. Working hours are flexible, and you can work either full-time or part-time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that customers receive their orders on time.

You are someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys working as part of a team. You value completing tasks neatly and on time. You are capable of working accurately and have no trouble standing or walking during your shift. You have a reasonable command of spoken and written English, enabling effective communication within the team. Logistics experience is a plus but not a requirement—you are a quick learner! You live within 20 kilometers of Lelystad.

Mandatory requirements:

- You have at least a VMBO level of education/aptitude
- You speak and write English
- You live within 20 km of Lelystad

As a warehouse employee at DHL, you help sort parcels and make sure each parcel ends up in the right place. Thanks to your work, parcels are sorted on time and delivered to customers.

You can start by placing parcels onto the conveyor belt so they can be sorted, or by taking sorted parcels off the belt and placing them in a roll cage. Later, DHL gives you the opportunity to learn and carry out other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: parcels can weigh up to 25 kg. Most parcels are lighter, but heavier parcels sometimes occur. You always lift these together with a colleague.

Working Hours

- Day shift: 08:00–16:00
- Evening shift: 16:00–00:00
- Intermediate shift: 18:00–02:00
- Night shift: 00:00–08:00

You can work across a maximum of two different shifts.

- You are available at least 3 to 4 days per week.
- You can lift parcels weighing up to 25 kg, with a colleague’s help for heavier parcels.
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle or scooter), or you live within walking distance of the sorting centre.
- You speak Dutch or English so you can communicate effectively with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- You live in or around Dordrecht, Rotterdam, Schiedam or Capelle aan den IJssel.

You’ll soon be working for a company that specializes in producing all kinds of stone worktops. These worktops are sold throughout the Netherlands and Germany and eventually end up in people’s homes, so there’s a good chance that you already have one of their worktops in your own kitchen!

As an Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the finishing tasks that cannot be completed by machines. You’ll be working on detailed operations using hand tools and small machinery. Once you’ve mastered your own process, you’ll have the opportunity to move on to the next department within production!

Your main tasks will include:

- Assembling materials using hand tools
- Reading technical drawings
- Performing quality checks
- Communicating with the machining department
- Keeping your workspace clean and organized

Your new job as an Assembly Worker takes place in a day shift, Monday to Friday, from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm. Leaving your weekends free!
